item.text: The public adapter already delegates directly to the domain function. The domain currently decodes each chunk separately, which fails on split UTF-8 codepoints, and strips CR from unterminated final lines. I’ll fix both behaviors and test them through both entry points.

import codecs


def decode_lines(chunks):
    \"\"\"Decode strict UTF-8 chunks into LF-delimited lines.\"\"\"
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(\"utf-8\")(errors=\"strict\")
    lines = []
    fragments = []

    def consume(text):
        parts = text.split(\"\\n\")
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            fragments.append(part)
            line = \"\".join(fragments)
            lines.append(line[:-1] if line.endswith(\"\\r\") else line)
            fragments.clear()
        if parts[-1]:
            fragments.append(parts[-1])

    for chunk in chunks:
        consume(decoder.decode(chunk))
    consume(decoder.decode(b\"\", final=True))
    if fragments:
        lines.append(\"\".join(fragments))
    return lines
EOF

import unittest

from workflow import api, incremental_utf8_lines


class DecodeLinesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_line_boundaries(self):
        cases = [
            ([], []),
            ([b\"\", b\"\"], []),
            ([b\"\\n\"], [\"\"]),
            ([b\"a\\n\\nb\\n\"], [\"a\", \"\", \"b\"]),
            ([b\"a\\r\", b\"\", b\"\\n\\r\", b\"\\nlast\"], [\"a\", \"\", \"last\"]),
            ([b\"a\\rb\\nlast\\r\"], [\"a\\rb\", \"last\\r\"]),
            ([b\"\\r\\r\\n\"], [\"\\r\"]),
            ([b\"\\r\"], [\"\\r\"]),
        ]
        for decode in (api.decode_lines, incremental_utf8_lines.decode_lines):
            for chunks, expected in cases:
                with self.subTest(entry=decode.__module__, chunks=chunks):
                    self.assertEqual(decode(iter(chunks)), expected)

    def test_utf8_at_every_chunk_boundary(self):
        data = \"é\\r\\n\\n€😀\\nfinal\\r\".encode(\"utf-8\")
        expected = [\"é\", \"\", \"€😀\", \"final\\r\"]
        for decode in (api.decode_lines, incremental_utf8_lines.decode_lines):
            for boundary in range(len(data) + 1):
                with self.subTest(entry=decode.__module__, boundary=boundary):
                    self.assertEqual(decode(iter([data[:boundary], data[boundary:]])), expected)
            self.assertEqual(decode(bytes([byte]) for byte in data), expected)

    def test_invalid_and_truncated_utf8(self):
        cases = [[b\"\\xff\"], [b\"\\xe2\", b\"\\x82\"], [b\"ok\\n\", b\"\\xf0\", b\"(\"],
                 [b\"\\xc0\\xaf\"], [b\"\\xed\\xa0\\x80\"]]
        for decode in (api.decode_lines, incremental_utf8_lines.decode_lines):
            for chunks in cases:
                with self.subTest(entry=decode.__module__, chunks=chunks):
                    with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError):
                        decode(iter(chunks))
